item.text:
According to the **ResStock 2025 Release 1 Technical Reference Guide**, Geometry Stories reports:

- **49%** of housing units are in one-story buildings (Table 11).
- **Data source:** U.S. Energy Information Administration’s **2009 Residential Energy Consumption Survey (RECS) microdata**.
- **Basements are excluded.** Stories count floors above grade; finished attics are included.

[Source: Geometry Stories, p. 54](https://nrel.github.io/ResStock.github.io/assets/trd/ResStockTechnicalReferenceGuide_2025_1.pdf#page=54).

The release’s [online characteristics table](https://resstock.readthedocs.io/en/2025_release_1/workflow_inputs/characteristics.html#geometry-stories) differs, listing **53%** for one story; **49% is the figure in the release’s technical reference guide**.
